test_title: PYST 47: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Reprieve
solution:
The correct answer is __**Continuation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Reprieve **means a cancellation or postponement of a punishment.
 
• The word **Continuation** means the action of carrying something on over time or the state of being carried on.
 
• The meaning of word **Reprieve **is opposite of the meaning of word **continuation.**
 
• *Hence Continuation is the answer.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Turn out **means prove to be case.

 
 
• *Example *: It **turns out** that Lisa is the criminal.
 
 
 
• **Torrential** means (of rain) falling quickly and in copious amounts.
 
 
• *Example* : The rain caused **torrential **flooding.
 
 
 
• **Cease** means put to an end.
 
 
• *Example *: These code violations must be **cease **forthwith.
